test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

This unfair proposal is objected to by us.

options.text: We are objecting this unfair proposal.
We object to this unfair proposal.
We have objected to this unfair proposal.

solution: The correct answer is** 'We object to this unfair proposal.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the question we have to change it into Active Voice. • The structure of the given sentence is as follows: • Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) * • *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)* • The subject of the given sentence is 'This unfair proposal'. • The object of the given sentence is 'us'. • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. • 'is objected to' will be changed into 'object to'. • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2. Correct Sentence:__ *We object to this unfair proposal.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य **Passive Voice** में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसेActive Voice में बदलना होगा। • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है: • Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) * • *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)* • दिए गए वाक्य का **subject** '**This unfair proposal**' है। • दिए गए वाक्य का **object **'**us**' है। • **Object** के स्थान पर **Subject** रखा जाएगा और **Subject** के स्थान पर **Object** रखी जाएगी। • **'is object to**' को '**object to**' में बदल दिया जाएगा। • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर** विकल्प 2** है। bd:T121b, The correct answer is** The teacher said to the students, “Can you prepare for the debate by next week?”**
